about.name: Sahabul Ahmed Asraf
about.intro: a motivated Computer Science undergraduate and entry-level Full Stack Web Developer.
about.paragraph1: I have hands-on project experience building websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and Tailwind CSS. I have also completed structured training in UI/UX Design (Figma) and Digital Marketing (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Email Marketing).
about.paragraph2: As a strong self-learner with a proven ability to independently build functional web applications, I deliver clean, user-focused designs. Seeking to apply my technical and problem-solving skills in a professional web development role.

projects.title: Movie Website
projects.desc: Built a responsive movie browsing website from scratch, implementing dynamic UI components and client-side interactivity using vanilla JavaScript.
projects.challenges: Building custom interactive carousels, responsive media cards, and real-time client-side search filtering without external frontend frameworks.
projects.improvements: Integrate live TMDB / IMDb REST API, movie trailer embeds, and personalized user bookmarking.

projects.title: Travel & Hotel Booking Website
projects.desc: Developed a full-featured travel and hotel booking platform using PHP for backend logic and HTML/CSS for the front end, covering search and booking workflows.
projects.challenges: Handling database relations for room availability, dynamic date range calculations, and booking state verification.
projects.improvements: Add automated email confirmation triggers and online payment gateway integration (SSLCommerz, bKash, Stripe).

projects.title: Fitness App UI Design
projects.desc: Designed a 3-page fitness application interface in Figma, applying UI/UX principles including layout hierarchy, color theory, and typography.
projects.challenges: Structuring workout tracking data with high readability, ergonomic mobile tap targets, and high-energy color palette.
projects.improvements: Create animated interactive component prototypes and design tokens for developer handoff.

projects.title: FarmersBD.com — Marketplace Website
projects.desc: Built a farmer-to-buyer marketplace website connecting farmers directly with buyers, using PHP for backend logic and HTML/CSS for the front-end interface.
projects.challenges: Facilitating direct marketplace interaction, item categorization, and clear product pricing displays for non-technical users.
projects.improvements: Bangla language support, SMS alert integrations for farmers, and order tracking logistics.

upcoming.title: FarmersBD 2.0 & Mobile Portal
upcoming.desc: A modernized digital agricultural marketplace enabling Bangladeshi farmers to directly showcase fresh crops and wholesale harvest to urban buyers and distributors with zero middlemen.
